# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 1.x.x   | :white_check_mark: |
| < 1.0   | :x:                |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

We take security vulnerabilities seriously. If you discover a security issue, please report it to us as soon as possible.

### How to Report

- **Do NOT open a public GitHub issue** for security vulnerabilities.
- Submit a private report using GitHub's **"Report a vulnerability"** feature under the **Security** tab of the repository: https://github.com/chriskyfung/ollama-model-scout/security
- Alternatively, you may email the maintainer directly at: **chriskyfung [at] gmail [dot] com**

### What to Include

In your report, please include:

- A description of the vulnerability
- Steps to reproduce the issue
- The potential impact
- Any suggested fixes (if known)

### Response Timeline

- If the vulnerability is accepted, we will work on a fix and aim to release a patch within **30 days** (or sooner for critical issues).
- We will not publicly disclose the vulnerability until a fix has been released.

### Safe Disclosure

We encourage responsible disclosure. Please do not publicly disclose any details about the vulnerability until a fix has been prepared and released.

Thank you for helping keep Ollama Model Scout secure!
